Four Context methods — set_config_key_value, get_config_key_value, delete_config_key_value, wait_at_barrier — called the bare module-level ensure_initialized() instead of self.ensure_initialized(). The bare call resolves to the module-level function, which initializes the global singleton context via context().ensure_initialized(), not necessarily self. ~25 sibling methods in the same class correctly call self.ensure_initialized().

Latent/harmless when self is the global singleton (the common case) — the bare call still initializes the same object as a side effect. Breaks for any separately-constructed Context() instance: self._context_handle stays None and gets passed directly to the C API, since these four methods skip the self._handle property's assertion and use self._context_handle raw.
